name: Image Texture Atlas Packing
definition: A technique to represent 3D volumetric data (e.g., MRI/CT scans) as a set of 2D image slices arranged into a single 2D texture (atlas) to emulate 3D textures in WebGL 1.0, which lacks native 3D texture support.
summary: Image Texture Atlas Packing represents 3D volumetric data as 2D slices in a single texture, enabling 3D rendering on hardware lacking native 3D texture support.
